author: Epic Games
description:
Play the Borderlands 4 Story Pack 2 DLC on September 10 on the Epic Games Store. https://epic.gm/borderlands4 

Team up with FL4K, an unequaled beastmaster who lives for The Hunt, to save their loyal skag companion Mr. Chew and teach the Tediore corporation a brutal lesson about primal nature.  

► New Vault Hunter Loveless the Hacker, who will be fully revealed in an upcoming episode of the Gearbox DevCast on September 3  
► New missions, activities, loot, and the lush new region Providence
► 2 Pearlescent weapons and 18 new pieces of Legendary loot  

Story Pack 2 DLC has two parts: new story content in FL4K and the Last Resort, and a playable Vault Hunter with Loveless the Hacker. Included in the Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition, Vault Hunter Pack, and available for separate purchase. Base game required.
title: Borderlands 4 | Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort | Reveal Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Gallipoli is a new authentic FPS game set on the Ottoman Fronts of WW1! Land on the beaches of Gallipoli and fight intense 50-player objective-based battles. Experience WW1 trench warfare and desert expeditions as one of 10 historic classes, armed with authentic weaponry. Gallipoli brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet!  

Get the game now with a 25% launch discount on the Epic Games Store. https://epic.gm/gallipoli

Play the S.T.A.L.K.E.R.2: Cost of Hope DLC now. https://epic.gm/stalker2-cohdlc

A New Journey   
Head out on a new expedition into the Zone in this massive, nonlinear expansion. Dozens of gameplay hours packed with unforgettable stories and twisted characters — wrapped in the signature atmosphere of decay with a flicker of hope.  

Between Duty and Freedom  
The fragile peace between the bitter rivals is shattered. Pick a side in a tangled web of intrigue and half-truths, where no choice is clean or truly right.   

You Won't Believe Where I've Been  
Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant — forbidden for decades — now calls to stalkers. Cut your way through Iron Forest mazes and never-before-seen locations.  

Face New Horrors and Wonders  
Brand-new weapons and gear will help you survive new mutated nightmares, lethal anomalies, and human threats on your brutal, unforgiving path.
